items.title: 成本壓力難擋家電業迎漲價 業者瞄準2027年新能效標準搶攻換機商機
items.title_en: Cost Pressures Spur Price Hikes in Home Appliance Industry; Players Target 2027 New Energy‑Efficiency Standards to Capture Replacement Market
paras: 台灣家電產業近期面臨銅、塑膠粒等原物料以及物流運費齊揚的沉重成本壓力，家電品牌廠與通路商紛紛啟動價格調整機制，包括聲寶(1604-TW)與燦坤(2430-TW)皆提出將會有漲價潮，且在加上經濟部修訂2027年即將上路的新版能源效率制度大幅拉高門檻，整體市場正迎來一波因應漲價與政策換軌的提前汰舊換新商機。
針對產品價格調幅與成本結構，聲寶說明雖然民生買氣偏向保守，但源頭原物料上漲已使業者難以承受，市場普遍預期一般冰箱與洗衣機產品漲幅落在3%至5%左右，其中受記憶體價格大漲影響，液晶電視成為成本反映最為明顯的主力品項。
通路龍頭燦坤也在今年稍早指出，空調與冰箱本體價格約上漲1000至3000元，空調安裝因銅管等原料走揚導致超出標準安裝費用增加20%至30%，中東戰事亦帶動塑膠原料緊繃，使風扇等小家電也面臨量縮價揚的壓力。
面對生產端成本上升與供給端價格調漲，各大家電業者積極轉向節能政策紅利尋求突破口。由於經濟部修訂冰箱能源效率分級標準與檢驗要求，2027年起能效門檻將大幅提高，促使通路與品牌提前啟動布局。
燦坤率先攜手國際一線品牌祭出一級能效冰箱與洗衣機8折起優惠，並搭配政府最高5000元的節能補助與貨物稅減徵，期望在政策過渡期擴大市占率並催化新一波汰換買氣。
品牌廠亦全力將核心產品線朝高能效與高毛利規格推動。三洋電(1614-TW)指出，隨著全台用電量攀升與能源基準調升，全系列空調與冰箱已全面符合一級能效，積極瞄準未來的節能換機潮。
禾聯碩(5283-TW)則在完成董事改選後確立未來三年落實本業轉型，聚焦開發高附加價值與高毛利產品，空調設備年銷維持20多萬台，並透過副品牌山田家電擴大市場滲透率。
在大環境面臨通膨、原物料成本墊高與消費保守等多重拉鋸下，台灣家電市場逐步走向高規格節能剛性需求的競爭格局。業者透過加速清理舊規庫存、切入2027新能效一級標準機型，並搭配資產活化與多元通路布局，力求在漲價潮與政策轉型期中穩固獲利韌性。
paras_en: Taiwan's home‑appliance sector is currently grappling with steep cost pressures as raw‑material prices—such as copper and plastic pellets—and logistics freight have all surged. Major brands and retailers are activating price‑adjustment mechanisms; both Sampo (1604‑TW) and Tsann‑Kuen (2430‑TW) have warned of an upcoming wave of price hikes. In addition, the Ministry of Economic Affairs is revising the energy‑efficiency regime slated for 2027, raising the standards dramatically, which together create an early‑stage replacement opportunity driven by both price increases and policy shifts.

Sampo explained that although consumer demand remains cautious, the rise in upstream raw‑material costs has become unbearable for the industry. The market generally expects price increases of about 3%‑5% for typical refrigerators and washing machines, while LCD TVs—hit hard by soaring memory‑chip prices—show the most pronounced cost pass‑through.

Tsann‑Kuen, a leading retailer, noted earlier this year that the base prices of air‑conditioners and refrigerators have risen by roughly NT$1,000‑3,000. Installation costs for air‑conditioners have jumped 20%‑30% because of higher copper‑tube prices, and the Middle‑East conflict has tightened plastic‑material supplies, putting pressure on small appliances such as fans to face both volume cuts and price hikes.

Facing higher production costs and upstream price adjustments, major appliance makers are actively seeking breakthroughs through energy‑efficiency incentives. The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ revision of refrigerator energy‑efficiency grading and testing requirements will raise the efficiency threshold substantially from 2027, prompting brands and retailers to pre‑emptively position themselves.

Tsann‑Kuen is first to partner with top international brands to offer up to 20% off on Class‑1‑efficiency refrigerators and washing machines, combined with the government’s maximum NT$5,000 energy‑saving subsidy and reduced commodity taxes, aiming to expand market share and spark a new wave of replacement purchases during the policy transition period.

Brand manufacturers are also pushing core product lines toward higher efficiency and higher‑margin specifications. Sanyo Electric (1614‑TW) said that, as nationwide electricity consumption climbs and energy benchmarks rise, its entire range of air‑conditioners and refrigerators now meets Class‑1 efficiency, positioning the company to capture the forthcoming energy‑saving replacement wave.

He Lian Shuo (5283‑TW) confirmed, after a board‑member election, a three‑year plan to transform its core business toward high‑value‑added, high‑margin products. It will maintain annual sales of over 200,000 air‑conditioning units and expand market penetration through its sub‑brand Yamada Home Appliances.

Amid broader inflation, rising raw‑material costs and cautious consumer sentiment, Taiwan’s home‑appliance market is gradually shifting toward a competitive landscape defined by high‑spec, energy‑efficient demand. Companies are accelerating the clearance of old‑stock, targeting 2027 Class‑1 models, and leveraging asset revitalization and diversified channel strategies to preserve profit resilience during the price‑rise and policy‑transition phases.

items.title: 大盤登頂誰最賺？18檔ETF同創新高 主動式、市值型、海外科技全上榜
items.title_en: Who Profits Most from the Market Rally? 18 ETFs Hit New Highs – Active, Cap‑Weighted and Overseas Tech All Make the List
paras: 台股加權指數 10 月 2 日以收盤48,475.74點再度刷新歷史新高，整體上市櫃股票總市值來到新台幣 170.17 兆元。在這波資金浪潮推升下，ETF 市場共計有 18 檔股價同創歷史新高，主動式 ETF 強勢占據 8 檔，投資標的橫跨台股、全球科技、網路資安及永續 ESG 等多元主題，顯示多頭行情正向各類主題式投資擴散。
今年主動式 ETF 掀起募集熱潮，在 18 檔創新高的 ETF 中，主動式 ETF 就有多達 8 檔，占比約 44%，顯示經理人透過靈活選股與動態調整策略，在創高行情中展現出色的超額報酬能力。
進一步觀察，包括主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)、主動摩根台灣鑫收(00401A-TW)、主動凱基台灣(00407A-TW)、主動野村台灣優選(00980A-TW)、主動野村台灣50(00985A-TW)、主動永豐科技趨勢(00410A-TW)，共有 6 檔為台股類型的主動 ETF。而主動安聯美國科技(00402A-TW)與主動復華全球50(00409-TW)為海外型主動 ETF。
隨著大盤創高，市值型與追蹤權值指數的被動型 ETF 依舊是資金攻堅的主力，高價指標如富邦摩台(0057-TW)與永豐臺灣加權(006204-TW)均展現極強的股價爆發力。國人偏好的市值型 ETF 如富邦台50(006208-TW)與 元大MSCI台灣(006203-TW)亦同步攀上新高峰。
除了台股本土型ETF外，海外科技與利基型產業 ETF 同樣受惠於全球科技浪潮與產業復甦，元大全球AI(00762-TW)與國泰網路資安(00875-TW)2 檔 ETF 續創佳績。
中信台日韓PCB(009828-TW) 9 月初甫掛牌上市，隨即遭遇載板、CCL 等族群各種「鬼故事」襲擊，009828 不僅跌破發行價 10 元，最低點更下探 9.16 元，但隨著籌碼重新匯聚，近兩周反彈力道猛烈， 10/2 以收盤價 10.68 元改寫掛牌新高。
法人表示，台股總市值突破 170 兆元，不僅反映基本面強勁，更代表市場資金對未來產業成長性抱持高度信心。投資人在布局創高行情時，建議可採兩大方向，核心配置方面，以市值型 ETF 或高權值主題為基礎，穩健參與大盤成長。而衛星配置則搭配主動型 ETF 或趨勢主題型 ETF，適度追求超額報酬。

paras_en: The Taiwan Weighted Index closed at 48,475.74 points on October 2, setting another historic high, with the total market value of listed stocks reaching NT$170.17 trillion. Amid this wave of capital inflows, 18 ETFs posted record‑high prices, eight of which are active‑managed funds, covering themes such as Taiwan equities, global technology, cybersecurity and sustainable ESG, indicating that the bull market is spreading across various thematic investments.

Active ETFs have sparked a fundraising boom this year. Among the 18 ETFs that reached new highs, active funds account for eight, about 44%, showing that managers’ flexible stock‑picking and dynamic adjustment strategies can deliver strong excess returns in a rallying market.

Looking closer, six of the active ETFs are Taiwan‑focused: Cathay Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW), Morgan Stanley Taiwan Xin‑Shou (00401A‑TW), KGI Taiwan (00407A‑TW), Nomura Taiwan Select (00980A‑TW), Nomura Taiwan 50 (00985A‑TW) and SinoPac Technology Trend (00410A‑TW). The other two – Allianz Active US Technology (00402A‑TW) and Fuhua Global 50 (00409‑TW) – are overseas‑focused active ETFs.

As the market hits new highs, cap‑weighted and index‑tracking passive ETFs remain the main flow of capital. High‑profile funds such as Fubon MoTai (0057‑TW) and SinoPac Taiwan Weighted (006204‑TW) have shown very strong price momentum. Popular domestic cap‑weighted ETFs like Fubon Taiwan 50 (006208‑TW) and Yuanta MSCI Taiwan (006203‑TW) also climbed to fresh peaks.

Beyond Taiwan‑focused ETFs, overseas technology and niche‑sector ETFs also benefited from the global tech wave and industry recovery. Yuanta Global AI (00762‑TW) and Cathay Cybersecurity (00875‑TW) each continued to post strong performance.

CITIC Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW) was listed in early September and immediately faced a series of “ghost story” setbacks in the PCB and CCL sectors. The fund fell below its NT$10 issue price, hitting a low of NT$9.16, but as capital re‑accumulated it rebounded sharply, closing at NT$10.68 on October 2 and setting a new post‑listing high.

Institutional investors note that the Taiwan market’s total valuation breaking NT$170 trillion not only reflects a strong fundamentals backdrop but also signals high confidence in future industry growth. When positioning for a record‑high market, they recommend two main approaches: a core allocation using cap‑weighted or high‑weight thematic ETFs for steady participation in market growth, and a satellite allocation with active or trend‑themed ETFs to seek excess returns.

paras_en: SpaceX’s Starship launch technology has achieved a pivotal breakthrough, not only driving orbital costs down to the extreme limit but also advancing low‑Earth‑orbit satellites from traditional communication relays to space edge‑computing nodes. With the era of direct‑to‑phone and space AI arriving, the hardware value per satellite is set to double, and a brand‑new super‑cycle in the space industry is poised to take off!
Starship dramatically cuts launch costs, paving the way for satellites to become space‑AI computers

The launch‑technology breakthrough is the core engine lifting low‑orbit satellite specifications. The third‑generation Starship boasts over 100 tonnes of payload capacity and full reusability, slashing the cost per kilogram from several thousand dollars to a few hundred dollars—or even below $200—thereby tearing down the cost barrier to orbit.

With low cost and massive payload capability, the next‑generation Starlink V3 satellites are evolving from pure communication nodes into “AI computing satellites,” integrating far more powerful edge‑compute, large solar arrays and advanced thermal‑management systems, officially ushering in a new era of space computing.
Direct‑to‑phone and space‑based computing are taking shape, boosting the value of RF transmission

As direct‑to‑consumer (D2C) phone links and inter‑satellite optical links become widespread, satellites face stricter demands for high‑frequency transmission and signal‑processing capability. To support multi‑band coverage and complex communication protocols, the amount of RF front‑end components, high‑frequency high‑speed PCBs and high‑power amplifiers on each satellite is doubling. Moreover, the harsh temperature swings and radiation resistance required in space raise the certification threshold for advanced materials, allowing core suppliers with mass‑production capacity to command higher unit prices and margins.

items.title: 美股Q4有望迎軋空行情！CTA持倉急轉空、1.3兆美元回購潮將啟動
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks May See a Short Squeeze in Q4 as CTA Positions Flip to Short and a $1.3 Trillion Buyback Wave Kicks Off
paras: 美股第四季行情可能迎來新的資金動能。隨著趨勢追蹤量化基金（CTA）大幅調整持倉，市場賣壓逐漸釋放，加上美國企業今年已核准創紀錄的1.3兆美元股票回購計畫，相關執行窗口將自10月15日起陸續重啟，為美股帶來潛在買盤。
Citadel Securities股票與股票衍生品策略主管Scott Rubner研究顯示，CTA整體持倉在短短一個月內出現劇烈轉變，從8月底的極度偏多轉為略偏空，持倉變化幅度超過3個標準差，近年相當罕見。
在賣壓逐步出清、企業回購資金即將進場之際，加上美國期中選舉年第四季的歷史季節性表現，市場出現潛在軋空行情的條件。

CTA持倉急轉空 1.3兆美元企業回購資金蓄勢待發

Rubner的研究指出，衡量CTA持倉偏離常態程度的Z值，已從8月底的正2.35大幅降至負0.80，代表量化基金從極度看多轉為低於中性水準。
隨著先前累積的多頭部位大幅減少，市場賣壓獲得釋放，後續資金流向也可能出現轉變。
企業回購則是另一項潛在支撐。美國企業今年已核准總額達1.3兆美元的股票回購計畫，其中相當一部分額度仍待執行。
隨著第三季財報靜默期結束，企業回購窗口將自10月15日起陸續重啟，歷史上回購活動通常在11月進一步升溫。
季節性因素也受到市場關注。根據Rubner的統計，自1930年以來，標普500指數在美國期中選舉年第四季平均上漲5.6%，接近所有年份第四季平均漲幅2.9%的兩倍。
其中，10月與11月通常是期中選舉年表現最強勁的月份。

利率壓力未阻科技股 AI資本支出展現韌性

儘管利率走升對市場形成壓力，科技股仍展現相對強勁的走勢。那斯達克100指數期貨逼近3萬1,200點的關鍵阻力位，50日均線重新轉為上行；費城半導體指數則已突破短期阻力區，逐漸逼近歷史高點。
AI基礎建設投資對利率變化的敏感度相對有限，是科技股維持韌性的關鍵因素之一。高盛預估，Google、亞馬遜等超大型雲端業者2027年債券發行規模將達4,200億美元，但利息支出占企業獲利的比重仍相當有限。
摩根士丹利的數據也顯示，這些業者淨槓桿率僅0.4倍，現金相當於債務總額的132%，顯示大型科技企業仍有充裕的資產負債表空間，AI基礎建設投資尚未面臨明顯的財務限制。
這也形成市場關注的利率不對稱效應：即使利率維持高檔，AI資本支出仍具延續性；若未來利率回落，科技股估值則可能進一步受惠。
半導體產業的市場預期調整，也為股價提供另一項潛在支撐。高盛指出，傳統記憶體與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的價格預期先前已大幅下修，目前開始出現修復跡象，投資人也逐漸關注相關產品價格上漲的可能性。
摩根大通則認為，半導體硬體產業的獲利前景依然穩健，台積電的AI加速器需求強勁，先進製程產能利用率更超過100%。
儘管資金面與科技股基本面為美股提供潛在支撐，原油市場仍是第四季需要留意的宏觀變數。
高盛指出，全球原油庫存雖然仍高於維持日常營運所需的最低水準，但緩衝空間已明顯縮小。在此情況下，油價升至每桶100美元，並不與目前的供需平衡狀況相矛盾。
另一方面，衡量原油市場波動預期的原油波動率指數（OVX），目前仍處於與油價低於每桶80美元時相近的水準。高盛認為，這可能代表市場對極端價格波動風險的定價仍不充分。
paras_en: U.S. equities could get a fresh boost of capital in the fourth quarter. As trend‑following quantitative funds (CTAs) dramatically adjust their holdings, selling pressure is gradually easing, and U.S. companies have approved a record‑size $1.3 trillion stock‑buyback program for this year. The execution window will reopen starting October 15, potentially providing a new source of buying for the market.

Research by Scott Rubner, head of equities and equity‑derivatives strategy at Citadel Securities, shows that CTA aggregate positions swung dramatically within a single month, moving from an extreme long bias at the end of August to a slight short bias. The shift exceeded three standard deviations, a rarity in recent years.

With selling pressure being cleared, corporate buyback funds about to flow in, and the historical seasonal strength of Q4 in U.S. midterm‑election years, conditions are forming for a possible short‑squeeze scenario.

Rubner’s analysis notes that the Z‑score measuring CTA positioning away from the norm fell sharply from +2.35 at the end of August to –0.80, indicating that quantitative funds have moved from a strongly bullish stance to below‑neutral.
As the previously accumulated long positions have been sharply trimmed, market‑selling pressure is being released, and subsequent capital flows could shift direction.
Corporate buybacks represent another potential support. U.S. firms have approved a total of $1.3 trillion in stock‑repurchase plans this year, with a sizable portion still pending execution.
With the quiet period after Q3 earnings ending, the buyback window will restart gradually from October 15, and historically buyback activity tends to heat up further in November.

Seasonal factors are also on investors’ radar. Rubner’s data show that since 1930 the S&P 500 has averaged a 5.6% gain in Q4 of U.S. midterm‑election years, roughly double the 2.9% average gain for all other years’ Q4.
October and November are typically the strongest months in midterm‑election‑year quarters.

Rising rates have not dampened tech stocks, whose AI‑related capital spending remains resilient. The Nasdaq‑100 futures are approaching the key resistance at 31,200 points, and the 50‑day moving average has turned upward; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has broken short‑term resistance and is edging toward historic highs.

AI infrastructure investment is relatively insensitive to rate changes, helping tech stocks maintain strength. Goldman Sachs estimates that mega‑cloud players such as Google and Amazon will issue $420 billion of bonds by 2027, yet interest expense will remain a modest share of earnings.

Morgan Stanley data show these firms have a net leverage of just 0.4 × and cash equal to 132% of total debt, indicating ample balance‑sheet capacity and no clear financial constraint on AI infrastructure spending.
This creates an asymmetric rate effect that the market watches: even if rates stay high, AI capex is likely to continue; if rates later fall, tech valuations could benefit further.

The semiconductor sector’s outlook adjustment also offers a potential price support. Goldman Sachs notes that price forecasts for traditional memory and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) have been sharply cut but are now showing signs of recovery, and investors are beginning to watch for possible price rebounds.
JPMorgan believes semiconductor hardware earnings remain solid, with strong AI‑accelerator demand for TSMC and advanced‑process capacity utilization exceeding 100%.
While capital flows and tech fundamentals provide potential support for U.S. equities, the oil market remains a macro variable to watch in Q4.

Goldman Sachs points out that global oil inventories, while still above the minimum needed for daily operations, have shrunk considerably, leaving less buffer. In this context, oil prices rising to $100 per barrel do not contradict the current supply‑demand balance.

Conversely, the oil volatility index (OVX), which gauges expected oil price swings, remains at levels similar to when oil was below $80 per barrel. Goldman Sachs argues this may indicate that the market is still under‑pricing the risk of extreme price moves.

items.title: 「對AI應採核電級別防護措施」！OpenAI安全系統團隊負責人辭職後撰文轟前東家企業文化
items.title_en: “AI Should Have Nuclear-Plant‑Level Safeguards”! OpenAI Safety Team Lead Resigns, Writes Piece Criticizing Former Employer’s Culture
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，OpenAI一名專注於AI安全的員工已從公司離職，並警告頂尖AI公司在降低風險方面做得還不夠。
負責OpenAI安全團隊透明度工作的David Robinson週六(3日)在《大西洋月刊》撰文指出，OpenAI「一直透過反覆試錯發展壯大」，但這種方式不可避免會有失敗的時候，隨著AI技術的能力不斷提升，這些失敗造成的風險也在加大，他還以OpenAI未能阻止其AI在測試過程中失控作為例證。
Robinson在文章中寫道，「我以前的同事都很聰明、工作努力，也努力做出正確的選擇，但隨著公司從一個產品發布衝向下一個產品發布，它並沒有達到我認為所需要的謹慎程度」，並稱真正需要的是「第一次就做到更接近完美」。
OpenAI一名發言人表示，Robinson上星期離開公司，此前也曾負責公司的政策規劃工作，並參與AI安全透明度工作，包括開發和發布模型「系統卡」。
近幾週，多家頂尖AI公司的員工都對該技術可能帶來的災難性風險發出警告。有些人甚至表示，AI有朝一日可能會消滅人類。
在此背景下，Anthropic執行長達Dario Amodei呼籲放慢開發最前沿模型的速度，並將引入第三方評估人員，協助審查以保證安全。業內其他人士，包括OpenAI執行長奧特曼及Grok的馬斯克，也公開支持Amodei的計畫。
文中還說，AI公司應該更像核電站那樣營運，「設置多層冗餘機制，並進行謹慎且耗時的規劃，以免偶發且不可避免的人為錯誤打開通往災難的大門」。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that an OpenAI employee focused on AI safety has left the company, warning that top AI firms are still falling short on risk mitigation.

David Robinson, who headed transparency for OpenAI’s safety team, wrote in The Atlantic on Saturday (the 3rd) that OpenAI “has grown through repeated trial‑and‑error,” but that this approach inevitably leads to failures; as AI capabilities increase, the risks from those failures grow, citing OpenAI’s inability to prevent its AI from going rogue during testing as an example.

Robinson wrote, “My former colleagues are smart, work hard, and strive to make the right choices, but as the company races from one product launch to the next, it has not reached the level of caution I believe is required,” adding that what’s truly needed is “getting it closer to perfect the first time.”

An OpenAI spokesperson said Robinson left the company last week; he had previously overseen policy planning and participated in AI safety transparency work, including the development and release of model “system cards.”
In recent weeks, employees at several leading AI firms have warned about the potentially catastrophic risks of the technology, with some even suggesting AI could one day wipe out humanity.

Against this backdrop, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing the pace of frontier‑model development and for bringing in third‑party evaluators to help review for safety. Other industry figures, including OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk of Grok, publicly backed Amodei’s plan.

The article also argued that AI companies should operate more like nuclear power plants, “installing multiple layers of redundancy and undertaking careful, time‑consuming planning to prevent an inevitable human error from opening the door to disaster.”

items.title: 馬斯克調高特斯拉AI5晶片記憶體至96GB！效能喊超越輝達、成本僅1成
items.title_en: Musk Raises Tesla AI5 Chip Memory to 96GB! Claims Performance Beats Nvidia, Cost Only One‑Tenth
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克透露，為避免特斯拉成為唯一採用最低72GB規格的業者，旗下AI5晶片將採用96GB記憶體，而非原先規劃的72GB DDR5記憶體。AI5晶片將用於支援Optimus人形機器人。
根據《Wccftech》報導，馬斯克先前曾表示，為了確保在全球記憶體供應創紀錄短缺的情況下，仍能取得足夠供貨，特斯拉已將AI5與AI6晶片的記憶體容量大幅縮減。
特斯拉AI5晶片是公司自動駕駛與機器人技術布局的核心，而馬斯克認為，這兩大領域將決定特斯拉的未來。馬斯克表示，AI5晶片已於4月完成下線（tape-out），他對這款硬體抱持高度期待。
他認為，單顆AI5晶片的效能將可媲美輝達(NVDA-US) Hopper系列AI GPU；若採用雙晶片配置，效能則可望達到更先進的Blackwell系列GPU水準。
馬斯克也認為，若以每瓦效能衡量，AI5晶片的表現將是輝達晶片的3倍。今年8月底，他曾表示，自己不僅已熟記AI5晶片的設計，還指出與輝達晶片相比，AI5的總成本僅為對方的10%。
馬斯克近日亦進一步透露AI5晶片的規格調整，表示特斯拉已將晶片搭載的LPDDR5記憶體容量減半。他在X平台發文指出：「我們將特斯拉AI5晶片的記憶體減半（目前採用72GB LP5），AI6則縮減三分之一（目前採用144GB LP6）。」
這項調整是為了因應記憶體市場持續短缺。馬斯克解釋，降低記憶體容量是確保供應穩定的唯一方式。
不過，馬斯克隨後補充，特斯拉決定將AI5記憶體容量從72GB小幅提高至96GB。他表示，若維持原先規格，特斯拉將成為唯一採用LPDDR5最低記憶體版本的公司，因此決定提高容量。
馬斯克也談及AI技術的發展速度。上個月，他曾坦言，AI目前「還不足以勝任極高效能軟體」的開發工作，但補充指出，AI很快就能具備這項能力。
近日，一名X平台用戶表示，若要判斷AI進步的速度，唯一的方法就是定期使用AI協助程式設計；然而，頻繁使用AI也可能提高出現「AI精神病」的風險，讓人難以向他人說明技術進步的幅度。馬斯克認同這項說法，僅簡短回覆：「確實如此。」
「AI精神病」一詞去年開始受到關注。加州大學一名精神科醫師當時警告，聊天機器人可能使原本就容易罹患精神病的使用者誘發相關症狀。
該醫師解釋，當現實與使用者原有的信念不符時，AI未能促使使用者調整自身信念體系，可能使他們更容易受到相關症狀影響。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk disclosed that to avoid Tesla being the only company using the minimum 72 GB specification, the AI5 chip will be equipped with 96 GB of memory instead of the originally planned 72 GB DDR5. The AI5 chip will be used to support the Optimus humanoid robot.

According to a report by Wccftech, Musk previously said that to ensure sufficient supply amid a record‑short global memory shortage, Tesla had dramatically reduced the memory capacity of its AI5 and AI6 chips.

The Tesla AI5 chip is central to the company’s autonomous‑driving and robotics strategy, and Musk believes these two areas will determine Tesla’s future. He noted that the AI5 chip completed tape‑out in April and he is highly optimistic about the hardware.
He believes a single AI5 chip can match Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) Hopper‑series AI GPUs, and a dual‑chip configuration could reach performance levels comparable to the newer Blackwell‑series GPUs.

Musk also said that on a per‑watt basis, the AI5 chip’s efficiency would be three times that of Nvidia’s chips. At the end of August he claimed he had memorized the AI5 design and that its total cost is only 10 % of Nvidia’s equivalent.

Musk recently revealed another specification tweak, stating Tesla has halved the LPDDR5 memory on the AI5 chip. In a post on X he wrote: “We have halved the memory on the Tesla AI5 chip (now using 72 GB LP5), and reduced the AI6 by a third (now using 144 GB LP6).”
The adjustment is meant to cope with the ongoing memory‑market shortage. Musk explained that cutting memory capacity is the only way to secure a stable supply.

However, Musk later added that Tesla decided to raise the AI5 memory from 72 GB to 96 GB. He said that keeping the original spec would make Tesla the sole company using the lowest‑capacity LPDDR5, so the capacity was increased.

Musk also discussed the speed of AI development. Last month he admitted that AI is “not yet capable of handling ultra‑high‑performance software” development, but added that AI will soon acquire that ability.

Recently, an X user suggested that the only way to gauge AI progress is to regularly use AI for programming assistance; however, frequent AI use might raise the risk of “AI psychosis,” making it hard to explain technological advances to others. Musk agreed, replying briefly: “Exactly.”

The term “AI psychosis” began attracting attention last year. A psychiatrist at the University of California warned that chatbots could trigger related symptoms in users already prone to mental illness.
The doctor explained that when reality conflicts with a user’s existing beliefs, AI’s failure to help the user adjust their belief system may make them more vulnerable to those symptoms.

items.title: 一份AI新報告指出：人類經濟「全面洗牌」幾已成定局
items.title_en: A New AI Report Says a Complete Economic Reshuffle Is Almost Certain
paras: 獨立信用評級與委託投票顧問機構 Egan-Jones 發布最新報告警告，最新 AI 模型在輸出品質與處理速度上已正式「跨越普及門檻」，未來經濟體系面臨「全面洗牌」幾乎已成定局。屆時，高薪專業人才、軟體服務業乃至房市，都將面臨劇烈震盪。
隨著人工智慧技術爆發性突破，市場對 AI 衝擊經濟的疑慮持續升溫。Egan-Jones 最新報告再次為市場敲響警鐘。隨著 AI 應用從概念驗證快速走向產業落地，資本市場與勞動力市場的重組風暴，才正要開始。
「按時計費」行業首當其衝 高階專業人才難倖免
Egan-Jones 在報告中明確指出，凡是依賴「按小時販售智慧資本」的行業——包括審計、投資銀行、管理諮詢、法律及工程等——將最先感受價格侵蝕與裁員潮的衝擊。
報告強調，小型團隊在 AI 加持下，已能創造出過往大型企業才有的產出規模，企業未來擴張不再依賴長期招聘。
值得注意的是，過去被視為護城河的高階主管與資深專業人員，因其專業知識已能被 AI 深度復刻，反而面臨極高替代風險。部分企業甚至能以極少、甚至零員工的狀態實現 24 小時不間斷營運。
軟體業面臨介面革命 創投回報率恐遭壓縮
除了專業服務業，軟體即服務 (SaaS) 領域亦面臨威脅。Egan-Jones 認為，傳統使用者與電腦互動的軟體介面，正迅速被簡便的 AI 對話平台所取代。
此外，AI 工具大幅降低了新創公司的運營成本與擴展門檻。
以 ChatGPT 為例，其用戶數僅歷時 3.8 年便突破 12 億大關，遠快於 Facebook 達標 10 億用戶所需的 8.6 年。新創公司無需巨額資金即可快速擴展，這意味著創投機構 (VC) 的議價能力與投資回報率將受到顯著擠壓。
螢幕工作者裁員潮 恐引爆房市短期修正
報告同時警示 AI 對實體經濟與資產價格的連鎖反應。由於當前許多家庭依賴雙薪支付高額房貸，加上房價相較於薪資水準已處於歷史高點，購屋者的財務緩衝空間極其脆弱。
隨著螢幕前工作者 (Screen-based workers) 面臨失業威脅，家庭收入的中斷將直接衝擊房地產市場，引發短期房價下行壓力。不過，Egan-Jones 亦補充，長期而言，基於人類對社群聚居與社交的需求，都市核心區的地產價值仍將具備長期支撐。
paras_en: Independent credit rating and proxy voting advisory firm Egan-Jones issued its latest report warning that the newest AI models have officially crossed the threshold of widespread adoption in both output quality and processing speed, and that a comprehensive reshuffling of the economy is now virtually inevitable. When it happens, high‑salary professionals, the software services sector and even the housing market will all face severe turbulence.

As breakthroughs in artificial intelligence accelerate explosively, concerns about AI’s impact on the economy are heating up. Egan-Jones’s new report sounds the alarm again. With AI applications moving quickly from proof‑of‑concept to real‑world deployment, the storm of restructuring in capital markets and labor markets is just beginning.
The “hourly‑billing” sector is hit first, and senior professionals are hard to spare

Egan-Jones explicitly points out that any industry that relies on “selling intellectual capital by the hour”—including auditing, investment banking, management consulting, legal services and engineering—will feel the price erosion and layoff wave first.

The report stresses that small teams, empowered by AI, can now produce output at a scale that previously required large enterprises, meaning future expansion will no longer depend on long‑term hiring.

Notably, senior executives and seasoned professionals once considered a moat are now at high risk of replacement because AI can deeply replicate their expertise. Some firms could even operate 24/7 with very few or zero employees.
Software industry faces an interface revolution, and venture‑capital returns may be squeezed

Beyond professional services, the software‑as‑a‑service (SaaS) sector also faces threats. Egan-Jones believes traditional software interfaces where users interact with computers are rapidly being supplanted by simple AI conversational platforms.
In addition, AI tools dramatically lower operating costs and entry barriers for startups.

Take ChatGPT as an example: it reached 1.2 billion users in just 3.8 years, far faster than the 8.6 years Facebook needed to hit 1 billion. Startups can scale quickly without massive capital, which means venture‑capital firms’ bargaining power and investment returns will be significantly compressed.
Screen‑based workers face layoffs, potentially triggering a short‑term housing correction

The report also warns of a chain reaction from AI on the real economy and asset prices. Many households currently rely on dual incomes to service large mortgages, and home prices are already at historic highs relative to wages, leaving buyers with very thin financial buffers.

As screen‑based workers confront unemployment threats, the resulting disruption to household income will directly hit the real‑estate market, creating short‑term downward pressure on home prices. However, Egan-Jones adds that over the long run, the intrinsic human need for community and social interaction will continue to support the value of properties in urban cores.

items.title: 傳台積電可能參加Terafab晶圓項目　馬斯克：僅處於討論階段 但可能有所進展
items.title_en: TSMC May Join Terafab Wafer Project; Musk Says It’s Only at the Discussion Stage but Could Progress
paras: 市場周六(3日)傳出台積電正評估與馬斯克旗下SpaceX、特斯拉共同發起的Terafab晶圓計畫合作，馬斯克則在X平台上回應稱相關接觸「僅處於討論階段」，但「可能會有所進展」，未承諾任何協議。
Terafab今年3月由馬斯克公布，規劃設於德州奧斯汀附近，由特斯拉、SpaceX推動，目標年產約1TW算力，供AI、自動駕駛、機器人與太空資料中心使用。
外界預估，初期投資金額為200億至250億美元，另有說法第一階段逾168億美元。該案早前已牽線英特爾，如今納入台積電，凸顯先進廠從零自建的技術、人才與良率門檻。
知情人士透露，雙方合作可能採兩套架構：一是由台積電持有並營運德州新廠，Terafab以股權加長期採購保證產能；二由Terafab握多數股，台積電出技術、營運與少量資金。
paras_en: The market reported on Saturday (the 3rd) that TSMC is evaluating a partnership on the Terafab wafer project launched jointly by Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Tesla. Musk responded on the X platform that the talks are “only at the discussion stage,” but “could see progress,” without committing to any agreement.

Terafab was announced by Musk in March of this year, with plans to locate near Austin, Texas, driven by Tesla and SpaceX. The project aims for an annual output of roughly 1 TW of compute power to serve AI, autonomous driving, robotics, and space data‑center applications.

Analysts estimate the initial investment at $20 billion to $25 billion, with some reports putting the first phase at over $16.8 billion. The deal, which previously involved Intel, now includes TSMC, highlighting the high technical, talent and yield barriers of building an advanced fab from scratch.

Sources familiar with the matter say the collaboration could take one of two structures: either TSMC would own and operate a new plant in Texas, with Terafab providing equity and long‑term purchase guarantees for capacity; or Terafab would hold a majority stake while TSMC supplies technology, operational expertise, and a modest amount of capital.

items.title: 成本壓力難擋家電業迎漲價 業者瞄準2027年新能效標準搶攻換機商機
items.title_en: Cost Pressures Spur Price Hikes in Home Appliance Industry; Players Target 2027 New Energy‑Efficiency Standards to Capture Replacement Market
paras: 台灣家電產業近期面臨銅、塑膠粒等原物料以及物流運費齊揚的沉重成本壓力，家電品牌廠與通路商紛紛啟動價格調整機制，包括聲寶(1604-TW)與燦坤(2430-TW)皆提出將會有漲價潮，且在加上經濟部修訂2027年即將上路的新版能源效率制度大幅拉高門檻，整體市場正迎來一波因應漲價與政策換軌的提前汰舊換新商機。
針對產品價格調幅與成本結構，聲寶說明雖然民生買氣偏向保守，但源頭原物料上漲已使業者難以承受，市場普遍預期一般冰箱與洗衣機產品漲幅落在3%至5%左右，其中受記憶體價格大漲影響，液晶電視成為成本反映最為明顯的主力品項。
通路龍頭燦坤也在今年稍早指出，空調與冰箱本體價格約上漲1000至3000元，空調安裝因銅管等原料走揚導致超出標準安裝費用增加20%至30%，中東戰事亦帶動塑膠原料緊繃，使風扇等小家電也面臨量縮價揚的壓力。
面對生產端成本上升與供給端價格調漲，各大家電業者積極轉向節能政策紅利尋求突破口。由於經濟部修訂冰箱能源效率分級標準與檢驗要求，2027年起能效門檻將大幅提高，促使通路與品牌提前啟動布局。
燦坤率先攜手國際一線品牌祭出一級能效冰箱與洗衣機8折起優惠，並搭配政府最高5000元的節能補助與貨物稅減徵，期望在政策過渡期擴大市占率並催化新一波汰換買氣。
品牌廠亦全力將核心產品線朝高能效與高毛利規格推動。三洋電(1614-TW)指出，隨著全台用電量攀升與能源基準調升，全系列空調與冰箱已全面符合一級能效，積極瞄準未來的節能換機潮。
禾聯碩(5283-TW)則在完成董事改選後確立未來三年落實本業轉型，聚焦開發高附加價值與高毛利產品，空調設備年銷維持20多萬台，並透過副品牌山田家電擴大市場滲透率。
在大環境面臨通膨、原物料成本墊高與消費保守等多重拉鋸下，台灣家電市場逐步走向高規格節能剛性需求的競爭格局。業者透過加速清理舊規庫存、切入2027新能效一級標準機型，並搭配資產活化與多元通路布局，力求在漲價潮與政策轉型期中穩固獲利韌性。
paras_en: Taiwan's home‑appliance sector is currently grappling with steep cost pressures as raw‑material prices—such as copper and plastic pellets—and logistics freight have all surged. Major brands and retailers are activating price‑adjustment mechanisms; both Sampo (1604‑TW) and Tsann‑Kuen (2430‑TW) have warned of an upcoming wave of price hikes. In addition, the Ministry of Economic Affairs is revising the energy‑efficiency regime slated for 2027, raising the standards dramatically, which together create an early‑stage replacement opportunity driven by both price increases and policy shifts.

Sampo explained that although consumer demand remains cautious, the rise in upstream raw‑material costs has become unbearable for the industry. The market generally expects price increases of about 3%‑5% for typical refrigerators and washing machines, while LCD TVs—hit hard by soaring memory‑chip prices—show the most pronounced cost pass‑through.

Tsann‑Kuen, a leading retailer, noted earlier this year that the base prices of air‑conditioners and refrigerators have risen by roughly NT$1,000‑3,000. Installation costs for air‑conditioners have jumped 20%‑30% because of higher copper‑tube prices, and the Middle‑East conflict has tightened plastic‑material supplies, putting pressure on small appliances such as fans to face both volume cuts and price hikes.

Facing higher production costs and upstream price adjustments, major appliance makers are actively seeking breakthroughs through energy‑efficiency incentives. The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ revision of refrigerator energy‑efficiency grading and testing requirements will raise the efficiency threshold substantially from 2027, prompting brands and retailers to pre‑emptively position themselves.

Tsann‑Kuen is first to partner with top international brands to offer up to 20% off on Class‑1‑efficiency refrigerators and washing machines, combined with the government’s maximum NT$5,000 energy‑saving subsidy and reduced commodity taxes, aiming to expand market share and spark a new wave of replacement purchases during the policy transition period.

Brand manufacturers are also pushing core product lines toward higher efficiency and higher‑margin specifications. Sanyo Electric (1614‑TW) said that, as nationwide electricity consumption climbs and energy benchmarks rise, its entire range of air‑conditioners and refrigerators now meets Class‑1 efficiency, positioning the company to capture the forthcoming energy‑saving replacement wave.

He Lian Shuo (5283‑TW) confirmed, after a board‑member election, a three‑year plan to transform its core business toward high‑value‑added, high‑margin products. It will maintain annual sales of over 200,000 air‑conditioning units and expand market penetration through its sub‑brand Yamada Home Appliances.

Amid broader inflation, rising raw‑material costs and cautious consumer sentiment, Taiwan’s home‑appliance market is gradually shifting toward a competitive landscape defined by high‑spec, energy‑efficient demand. Companies are accelerating the clearance of old‑stock, targeting 2027 Class‑1 models, and leveraging asset revitalization and diversified channel strategies to preserve profit resilience during the price‑rise and policy‑transition phases.

items.title_en: Who Profits Most from the Market Rally? 18 ETFs Hit New Highs – Active, Cap‑Weighted and Overseas Tech All Make the List
paras: 台股加權指數 10 月 2 日以收盤48,475.74點再度刷新歷史新高，整體上市櫃股票總市值來到新台幣 170.17 兆元。在這波資金浪潮推升下，ETF 市場共計有 18 檔股價同創歷史新高，主動式 ETF 強勢占據 8 檔，投資標的橫跨台股、全球科技、網路資安及永續 ESG 等多元主題，顯示多頭行情正向各類主題式投資擴散。
今年主動式 ETF 掀起募集熱潮，在 18 檔創新高的 ETF 中，主動式 ETF 就有多達 8 檔，占比約 44%，顯示經理人透過靈活選股與動態調整策略，在創高行情中展現出色的超額報酬能力。
進一步觀察，包括主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)、主動摩根台灣鑫收(00401A-TW)、主動凱基台灣(00407A-TW)、主動野村台灣優選(00980A-TW)、主動野村台灣50(00985A-TW)、主動永豐科技趨勢(00410A-TW)，共有 6 檔為台股類型的主動 ETF。而主動安聯美國科技(00402A-TW)與主動復華全球50(00409-TW)為海外型主動 ETF。
隨著大盤創高，市值型與追蹤權值指數的被動型 ETF 依舊是資金攻堅的主力，高價指標如富邦摩台(0057-TW)與永豐臺灣加權(006204-TW)均展現極強的股價爆發力。國人偏好的市值型 ETF 如富邦台50(006208-TW)與 元大MSCI台灣(006203-TW)亦同步攀上新高峰。
除了台股本土型ETF外，海外科技與利基型產業 ETF 同樣受惠於全球科技浪潮與產業復甦，元大全球AI(00762-TW)與國泰網路資安(00875-TW)2 檔 ETF 續創佳績。
中信台日韓PCB(009828-TW) 9 月初甫掛牌上市，隨即遭遇載板、CCL 等族群各種「鬼故事」襲擊，009828 不僅跌破發行價 10 元，最低點更下探 9.16 元，但隨著籌碼重新匯聚，近兩周反彈力道猛烈， 10/2 以收盤價 10.68 元改寫掛牌新高。
法人表示，台股總市值突破 170 兆元，不僅反映基本面強勁，更代表市場資金對未來產業成長性抱持高度信心。投資人在布局創高行情時，建議可採兩大方向，核心配置方面，以市值型 ETF 或高權值主題為基礎，穩健參與大盤成長。而衛星配置則搭配主動型 ETF 或趨勢主題型 ETF，適度追求超額報酬。

paras_en: The Taiwan Weighted Index closed at 48,475.74 points on October 2, setting another historic high, with the total market value of listed stocks reaching NT$170.17 trillion. Amid this wave of capital inflows, 18 ETFs posted record‑high prices, eight of which are active‑managed funds, covering themes such as Taiwan equities, global technology, cybersecurity and sustainable ESG, indicating that the bull market is spreading across various thematic investments.

Active ETFs have sparked a fundraising boom this year. Among the 18 ETFs that reached new highs, active funds account for eight, about 44%, showing that managers’ flexible stock‑picking and dynamic adjustment strategies can deliver strong excess returns in a rallying market.

Looking closer, six of the active ETFs are Taiwan‑focused: Cathay Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW), Morgan Stanley Taiwan Xin‑Shou (00401A‑TW), KGI Taiwan (00407A‑TW), Nomura Taiwan Select (00980A‑TW), Nomura Taiwan 50 (00985A‑TW) and SinoPac Technology Trend (00410A‑TW). The other two – Allianz Active US Technology (00402A‑TW) and Fuhua Global 50 (00409‑TW) – are overseas‑focused active ETFs.

As the market hits new highs, cap‑weighted and index‑tracking passive ETFs remain the main flow of capital. High‑profile funds such as Fubon MoTai (0057‑TW) and SinoPac Taiwan Weighted (006204‑TW) have shown very strong price momentum. Popular domestic cap‑weighted ETFs like Fubon Taiwan 50 (006208‑TW) and Yuanta MSCI Taiwan (006203‑TW) also climbed to fresh peaks.

Beyond Taiwan‑focused ETFs, overseas technology and niche‑sector ETFs also benefited from the global tech wave and industry recovery. Yuanta Global AI (00762‑TW) and Cathay Cybersecurity (00875‑TW) each continued to post strong performance.

CITIC Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW) was listed in early September and immediately faced a series of “ghost story” setbacks in the PCB and CCL sectors. The fund fell below its NT$10 issue price, hitting a low of NT$9.16, but as capital re‑accumulated it rebounded sharply, closing at NT$10.68 on October 2 and setting a new post‑listing high.

Institutional investors note that the Taiwan market’s total valuation breaking NT$170 trillion not only reflects a strong fundamentals backdrop but also signals high confidence in future industry growth. When positioning for a record‑high market, they recommend two main approaches: a core allocation using cap‑weighted or high‑weight thematic ETFs for steady participation in market growth, and a satellite allocation with active or trend‑themed ETFs to seek excess returns.

With the era of direct‑to‑phone and space AI arriving, the hardware value per satellite is set to double, and a brand‑new super‑cycle in the space industry is poised to take off!
Starship dramatically cuts launch costs, paving the way for satellites to become space‑AI computers

The launch‑technology breakthrough is the core engine lifting low‑orbit satellite specifications. The third‑generation Starship boasts over 100 tonnes of payload capacity and full reusability, slashing the cost per kilogram from several thousand dollars to a few hundred dollars—or even below $200—thereby tearing down the cost barrier to orbit.

With low cost and massive payload capability, the next‑generation Starlink V3 satellites are evolving from pure communication nodes into “AI computing satellites,” integrating far more powerful edge‑compute, large solar arrays and advanced thermal‑management systems, officially ushering in a new era of space computing.
Direct‑to‑phone and space‑based computing are taking shape, boosting the value of RF transmission

As direct‑to‑consumer (D2C) phone links and inter‑satellite optical links become widespread, satellites face stricter demands for high‑frequency transmission and signal‑processing capability. To support multi‑band coverage and complex communication protocols, the amount of RF front‑end components, high‑frequency high‑speed PCBs and high‑power amplifiers on each satellite is doubling. Moreover, the harsh temperature swings and radiation resistance required in space raise the certification threshold for advanced materials, allowing core suppliers with mass‑production capacity to command higher unit prices and margins.
